raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Stream text inside schema-constrained Qwen XML array/object arguments before the parameter closes. A `write_file(files=[{file_path, content}])` call keeps its array and final argument representation while exposing long file content progressively.

## Claims

- Enable nested streaming only when the request still carries the exact server-attached parameter grammar, for tools constrained to containers with string leaves.
- Preserve append-only argument prefixes and the existing final JSON representation on supported inputs, including chunked escapes and Unicode.
- Keep buffering for non-strict tools, unsupported schemas, disabled constraints, and requests whose constraint provenance is unavailable. No new dependency or public API field is introduced.
- Change argument visibility, not model generation throughput or tool execution/atomic commit semantics. Clients must accumulate and validate the complete call before execution.

## Validation

Base: `5d55ef1590c92213e3893dc8e8712f7f2e0bc508`.

The engine suite, compatibility suite and real-server regression were rerun successfully for publication on 2026-11-02 (Asia/Shanghai), using the same source diff and independent test environments. The patch also applies cleanly to upstream `8530a778f78dc7cd9a31e108ebc035c4b27ceb3c`; the recorded runtime results remain for the tested base above.

| Check | Unmodified base | This change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Six real-parser visibility cases, string/array/object, 1/16-character chunks | 4 failed, 2 passed | All pass |
| Entire `tests/parser/engine` suite | — | 6,114 passed |
| Structural-tag registry, abstract parser, Qwen parser | — | 399 passed |
| Real OpenAI streaming regression | Fails `assert len(fragments) > 2`; exactly 2 argument fragments | Passes, including final JSON equality and incomplete-prefix checks |
| Changed-file pre-commit hooks | — | Passed, including mypy and CI tethering |
| Documentation | — | MkDocs build passed with API autonav excluded; existing unrelated cross-reference warnings |

The end-to-end test uses `RemoteOpenAIServer`, `Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B` revision `c1899de289a04d12100db370d81485cdf75e47ca`, an RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, Python 3.12.7, PyTorch 2.14.0+cu130 and xgrammar 0.2.8. The editable checkout uses the exact-base precompiled wheel. String enums make the generated file content deterministic while retaining a real model, the `files` array, strict grammar, HTTP/SSE and the native `qwen3_xml` parser. No external parser plugin or tool executor is used.

Deterministic string enums validate parser visibility and final argument integrity; they do not establish instruction-following quality for arbitrary prompts. Deployment observations from older vLLM versions and external plugins are not included as validation of this upstream patch.

```bash
python -m pytest tests/parser/engine -q
python -m pytest tests/tool_parsers/test_structural_tag_registry.py tests/parser/test_abstract_parser.py tests/parser/engine/test_qwen3.py -q
python -m pytest tests/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/test_completion_with_function_calling.py -k qwen_xml_streams_nested -v -s
API_AUTONAV_EXCLUDE=vllm mkdocs build
```

For the before result, apply only the new test file to the base checkout and run the same end-to-end command. The existing OpenAI CI step selects the end-to-end test; this PR also wires the engine suite into the active CPU tool-parser step and removes its obsolete untethered-test entries.

<details>
<summary>CPU replay cost and visibility</summary>

Same host (i7-14700K), 16-character input chunks, five repetitions per case. This is parser-only replay, not a token/s benchmark. Each measured stream equals its non-streaming result byte for byte.

| 65,536-character payload | Base median | Patched median | Base → patched argument fragments |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Top-level string, non-strict | 32.54 ms | 36.92 ms | 4,098 → 4,098 |
| Array, non-strict | 18.74 ms | 22.20 ms | 2 → 2 |
| Array, strict | 18.70 ms | 38.69 ms | 2 → 4,101 |

For the strict array, the first content appears after 96 input characters instead of 65,664. The patched median is 0.80/9.16/38.69 ms at 1,024/16,384/65,536 content characters; the 65,536 case ranges from 38.40 to 39.40 ms. Earlier and more numerous events cost CPU, and the eligibility checks also add overhead on fallback paths. These measurements do not establish an inference speedup or an end-to-end latency percentage.

</details>

## Details

`ParserEngine._safe_arg_prefix` deliberately withholds a trailing container because reparsing/coercion can otherwise invalidate emitted text. This change opts in only to a constrained subset: inline string schemas, homogeneous arrays, and objects with `additionalProperties: false` and every declared property required. References, unions, numeric/boolean/null leaves and optional object fields keep the current path.

The common adjustment path records the installed structural tag and uniquely named strict tools. That small metadata addition is necessary because request rendering constructs the grammar and response parsing uses a different parser instance. It does not alter another parser's conversion behavior or reuse the reasoning-sensitive `_grammar_from_parser` flag. Format unions, replaced grammar and serialized requests without the private metadata do not enable this path.

The Qwen-specific incremental scanner handles only appended text and normalizes JSON whitespace/escapes to the existing converter's representation. It reuses the existing parameter extender and final prefix-consistency check. Reset, multiple calls/files, disabled argument streaming, truncation and fallback gates are covered. The outer argument object is not closed speculatively.

The pre-existing XML delimiter limitation remains: literal `</parameter>` or `<parameter=` inside a JSON string may be read as markup even under JSON constraints. The added regression verifies that the stream does not complete a file batch in this case; this PR does not claim general XML escaping support.

Proxies must preserve tool-schema constraints, including `additionalProperties: false` and `strict` when supplied. If the effective constraints no longer satisfy the eligibility checks, nested arguments retain the existing buffered behavior.

Related work: merged [#46351](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/46351) enabled top-level strings. Open [#63385](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63385) repairs/coerces argument types and preserves prefixes; [#55574](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/55574) recursively coerces decoded container children. This PR adds earlier nested visibility under an active strict grammar, rather than general coercion. Those overlapping internals will require rebasing/retesting if either lands first; combined compatibility is not claimed.

Also checked before submission: [#53739](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53739) handles completion of unextendable/truncated prefixes, and [#59145](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/59145) aligns grammar markers with parser token IDs. Neither implements the strict nested-string visibility path proposed here; combined compatibility has not been tested.

AI assistance was used to implement, test and document this change. The human submitter remains responsible for reviewing every changed line and rerunning the relevant validation before publication.

@@ -880,6 +880,7 @@ steps:
   device: cpu-small
   commands:
   - pytest -v -s tool_parsers

@@ -531,6 +531,32 @@ Supported models:
 
 Flags: `--tool-call-parser qwen3_xml`
 
+With `stream: true`, `qwen3_xml` can emit text inside nested array/object
+parameters before the XML parameter closes. Set `strict: true` in the tool's
+`function`, or use `--tool-strict-level parameter`, to enforce its parameter
+schema. This applies to containers whose leaves are strings: each object must
+set `additionalProperties: false` and require every declared property; arrays
+must declare an `items` schema. For example, a `files` array of objects with
+required string `file_path` and `content` properties streams progressively
+without changing the array or splitting it into separate tool calls. Default
+non-strict tools retain buffering; see [Strict Mode](#strict-mode).
+
+The parser enables this path only for parameter constraints attached by the
+server. It retains buffering for unsupported schemas (including references,
+unions and numeric leaves), non-strict tools, disabled structural-tag
+enforcement, and requests combining tool grammar with a separate output format.
+Requests crossing a serialization boundary that drops the server's private
+grammar metadata also retain buffering. Top-level string streaming is unchanged.
+
+Argument deltas are incomplete JSON prefixes. Accumulate the entire call and
+validate it before executing the tool; a truncated stream must not commit a
+partial file batch. This changes when argument text becomes visible, not model
+generation speed or tool execution semantics.
+
+The existing XML delimiter limitation still applies: literal `</parameter>` or
+`<parameter=` inside a JSON string can be interpreted as markup. Such a stream
+can remain incomplete; strict JSON constraints do not escape XML delimiters.
+
 ### MiMo-V2.6 Models (`mimo`)
 
 Supported models:

+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_qwen_xml_streams_nested_file_content(qwen_xml_server):
+    """Real SSE exposes nested code before the complete atomic file batch."""
+    content = "\n".join(f"// line {i}: example content" for i in range(48))
+    expected = {

+    }

+        full = await client.chat.completions.create(**kwargs)
+        baseline = full.choices[0].message.tool_calls[0].function.arguments
+        stream = await client.chat.completions.create(**kwargs, stream=True)
+        fragments = []
+        finish_reason = None
+        async for chunk in stream:
+            for choice in chunk.choices:
+                finish_reason = choice.finish_reason or finish_reason
+                for call in choice.delta.tool_calls or []:
+                    if call.function and call.function.arguments:
+                        fragments.append(call.function.arguments)
+    # A forced named tool reports "stop" under the existing API contract.
+    assert finish_reason == "stop"
+    arguments = "".join(fragments)
+    assert json.loads(arguments) == json.loads(baseline) == expected
+    jsonschema.validate(json.loads(arguments), parameters)
+    assert len(fragments) > 2
+    prefix = ""
+    for fragment in fragments[:-1]:
+        prefix += fragment
+        with pytest.raises(json.JSONDecodeError):
+            json.loads(prefix)
+    assert "line 0" in prefix

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["string", "array", "object"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("chunk_size", [1, 16])
+def test_nested_parameter_text_visible_before_xml_close(kind, chunk_size):
+    """Nested text should become visible while the model is still generating it."""
+    from tokenizers import Tokenizer, models
+    from transformers import TokenizersBackend
+
+    from vllm.entrypoints.openai.chat_completion.protocol import ChatCompletionRequest
+    from vllm.parser.parser_manager import ParserManager
+    from vllm.parser.qwen3 import Qwen3Parser
+
+    tokenizer = TokenizersBackend(
+        tokenizer_object=Tokenizer(models.WordLevel({"[UNK]": 0}, unk_token="[UNK]")),
+        unk_token="[UNK]",
+    )
+    value = 'alpha beta "quoted" \\ path\n中文 😀 ' + "more text " * 40
+    schema: dict = {"type": "string"}
+    if kind == "array":
+        value = [{"text": value}]
+        schema = {
+            "type": "array",
+            "items": {
+                "type": "object",
+                "properties": {"text": {"type": "string"}},
+                "required": ["text"],
+                "additionalProperties": False,
+            },
+        }
+    elif kind == "object":
+        value = {"text": value}
+        schema = {
+            "type": "object",
+            "properties": {"text": {"type": "string"}},
+            "required": ["text"],
+            "additionalProperties": False,
+        }
+    request = ChatCompletionRequest(
+        model="parser-test",
+        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Emit the payload."}],
+        tools=[
+            {
+                "type": "function",
+                "function": {
+                    "name": "emit_payload",
+                    "strict": True,
+                    "parameters": {
+                        "type": "object",
+                        "properties": {"payload": schema},
+                        "required": ["payload"],
+                        "additionalProperties": False,
+                    },
+                },
+            }
+        ],
+        tool_choice="auto",
+        stream=True,
+    )
+    raw_value = value if kind == "string" else json.dumps(value)
+    text = (
+        "<tool_call><function=emit_payload><parameter=payload>"
+        f"{raw_value}</parameter></function></tool_call>"
+    )
+    parser_kwargs = {"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": False}}
+    parser_cls = ParserManager.get_parser(
+        tool_parser_name="qwen3_xml", enable_auto_tools=True
+    )
+    assert parser_cls is not None
+    parser_cls(tokenizer, request.tools, **parser_kwargs).adjust_request(request)
+    nonstream = Qwen3Parser(tokenizer, request.tools, **parser_kwargs)
+    expected = (
+        nonstream.extract_tool_calls(text, request).tool_calls[0].function.arguments
+    )
+    parser = Qwen3Parser(tokenizer, request.tools, **parser_kwargs)
+    results = simulate_tool_streaming(
+        parser,
+        request,
+        [text[i : i + chunk_size] for i in range(0, len(text), chunk_size)],
+    )
+    results.append((parser.finish_streaming(), text))
+    assert json.loads(collect_tool_arguments(results)) == {"payload": value}
+    cumulative = ""
+    for delta, consumed in results:
+        cumulative += collect_tool_arguments([(delta, consumed)])
+        assert expected.startswith(cumulative)
+    before_close = [result for result in results if "</parameter>" not in result[1]]
+    assert "alpha beta" in collect_tool_arguments(before_close)
+
+

+    if gate == "mixed_tools":

+def _is_string_tree(schema: dict, depth: int = 0) -> bool:
+    if depth > 64 or any(
+        k in schema
+        for k in ("$ref", "anyOf", "oneOf", "allOf", "prefixItems", "patternProperties")
+    ):
+        return False
+    kind = schema.get("type")
+    if kind == "string":
+        return True
+    if kind == "array":
+        items = schema.get("items")
+        return isinstance(items, dict) and _is_string_tree(items, depth + 1)
+    if kind == "object" and schema.get("additionalProperties") is False:
+        props = schema.get("properties", {})
+        required = schema.get("required", [])
+        if not isinstance(required, list) or not isinstance(props, dict):
+            return False

+            props
+        ):
+            return False
+        return all(
+            isinstance(prop, dict) and _is_string_tree(prop, depth + 1)
+            for prop in props.values()

+class _StringTreeStream:
+    """Canonicalize appended JSON containing only containers and strings."""
+
+    _TEXT = re.compile(r'[^"\\\x00-\x1f]+')
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.pending = ""
+        self.in_string = False
+
+    def feed(self, delta: str) -> str:
+        text = self.pending + delta
+        self.pending = ""
+        out: list[str] = []
+        i = 0
+        while i < len(text):
+            c = text[i]
+            if self.in_string:
+                match = self._TEXT.match(text, i)
+                if match is not None:
+                    out.append(match[0])
+                    i = match.end()
+                    continue
+                if c == "\\":
+                    if i + 1 == len(text):
+                        break
+                    end = i + (6 if text[i + 1] == "u" else 2)
+                    if end > len(text):
+                        break
+                    if (
+                        text[i + 1] == "u"
+                        and 0xD800 <= int(text[i + 2 : end], 16) <= 0xDBFF
+                    ):
+                        if len(text) < end + 2:
+                            break
+                        if text[end : end + 2] == "\\u":
+                            if len(text) < end + 6:
+                                break
+                            if 0xDC00 <= int(text[end + 2 : end + 6], 16) <= 0xDFFF:
+                                end += 6
+                    decoded = json.loads('"' + text[i:end] + '"')
+                    out.append(json.dumps(decoded, ensure_ascii=False)[1:-1])
+                    i = end
+                    continue

+                    raise ValueError("Invalid constrained JSON string")

+            elif c == '"':

+            elif c in " \t\r\n":
+                i += 1

+            elif c not in "[]{}:,":

+            i += 1

+        return "".join(out)
